crossRefs.note: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…
Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust…
Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire…
“Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
The sun will be no more your light by day; nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be…
Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he…
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ…
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Come, O house of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.
translations.kjv: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
translations.asv: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of Jehovah.
